messages.subject: Error: package 'JGR' 1.7-0 was found, but < 1.7 is required by  'Deducer'
parts:
I don't currently use JGR so if there's a way to remove it from my
system then maybe this message would go away?

Anyway, just reporting it as a confusion point.

- Mark

messages.subject: Re: Error: package 'JGR' 1.7-0 was found, but < 1.7 is required by  'Deducer'
parts:
Which was fixed by installing the JGR version on CRAN instead of
whatever I had on the machine previously.

Deducer menu is now visible so I can play with it.

thanks!
